milestone.title: Verify M15 cleanup (TypedCache panic + Reader/Writer splits)

intent.outcome: The two M15 'Mostly done' audit findings are evidence-backed: TypedCache type-mismatch behavior is verified to not panic, and every state-mutating service in internal/brew/ exposes both Reader and Writer interfaces symmetrically.

problem.description: Master-plan audit (2026-07-19) marked M15 partial with two open items: (a) TypedCache panic path from M19.0 needs verification, (b) Reader/Writer split completeness needs audit. Without this milestone, M15 closure is unverified.

in_scope: Verify TypedCache returns zero value + invalidates key on type mismatch (existing TestTypedCacheWrongTypeReturnsMiss at internal/brew/cache_test.go:131).
Audit Reader/Writer split symmetry across internal/brew/ services (run grep + diff).
If gaps found, add minimal targeted tests OR add small documentation comment noting nil-cache behavior is intentional.
Record findings as mp milestone evidence.
out_of_scope: Implementing new services or splitting existing ones.
Refactoring code unrelated to M15's two open items.
Changing TypedCache public API (e.g., adding Close method).

acceptance_criteria.description: TypedCache.Get on a cache whose entry has a wrong type returns zero value, invalidates the stale entry, and does not panic.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: go test -race -run TestTypedCacheWrongTypeReturnsMiss ./internal/brew/ = PASS (1.278s). Test at internal/brew/cache_test.go:131 stores int in TypedCache[string], calls Get, asserts: (1) ok==false, (2) val=='' (zero value), (3) underlying cache no longer contains the key. Both observable behaviors verified; not a tautology.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every state-mutating service in internal/brew/ exposes both Reader and Writer interfaces symmetrically.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: comm -23 <(grep -lE '^type [A-Z]\w+Reader\b' internal/brew/*.go | sort -u) <(grep -lE '^type [A-Z]\w+Writer\b' internal/brew/*.go | sort -u) returns no output (no Reader-only files); comm -13 returns no output (no Writer-only files)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Reader files (6): casks.go, doctor.go, formulae.go, services.go, taps.go, trust.go. Writer files (6): same set. comm -23 (Reader-only): empty. comm -13 (Writer-only): empty. 12 interfaces total (6 Reader + 6 Writer), 1:1 symmetric across all state-mutating services.

steps.action: Run go test -run TestTypedCacheWrongTypeReturnsMiss ./internal/brew/... to confirm the TypedCache type-mismatch fix is in place (originally added as part of the typed-cache cleanup step).
steps.done_when: go test -run TestTypedCacheWrongTypeReturnsMiss ./internal/brew/... exits 0 and PASS

steps.action: Audit Reader/Writer split symmetry: every file with a Reader interface must also have a Writer, and vice versa.
steps.tests: manual: comm -23 and comm -13 of file lists returns empty (no asymmetric splits)
steps.done_when: Both comm commands return no output, confirming symmetric R/W splits across all internal/brew/ services

verification.evidence: M02 self-verification: M15 'Mostly done' claims are evidence-backed. AC-01 (TypedCache no-panic on type mismatch): existing TestTypedCacheWrongTypeReturnsMiss at internal/brew/cache_test.go:131 passes. AC-02 (R/W split symmetry): all 6 services expose both interfaces; comm commands confirm no asymmetric splits. No code changes required.
